about.title: About LaptopDoctor
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for professional PC and laptop repair
about.whoWeAreDesc: LaptopDoctor is a professional PC and laptop repair service dedicated to providing fast, reliable, and affordable solutions for all your device needs. With years of experience in the industry, our certified technicians handle everything from simple upgrades to complex data recovery.
about.experienceDesc: Our team brings extensive expertise in diagnosing and repairing all brands and models. We stay up-to-date with the latest technology and repair techniques to ensure the best service for our customers.
about.privacyDesc: We understand that your data is precious. Every device is handled with strict confidentiality. We never access, copy, or share your personal files without your explicit consent.
about.honestDiagnosisDesc: We believe in transparent communication. Our technicians provide detailed diagnostics and clear explanations of what needs to be fixed, so you can make informed decisions.
about.noCostsDesc: What we quote is what you pay. We provide upfront pricing with no surprise charges. Diagnostics are free, and you only pay when you approve the repair.
about.warrantyDesc: All our repairs come with a warranty period. If the same issue recurs within the warranty period, we'll fix it at no additional cost.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services
faq.a1: Most devices are diagnosed within 1-2 hours. For complex issues, it may take up to 24 hours. We always aim for same-day diagnostics.
faq.q2: Can you recover data from a dead HDD/SSD?
faq.a2: Yes, we specialize in data recovery from failed, damaged, or corrupted storage devices. Success depends on the type and extent of damage, but we have a high recovery rate.
faq.a3: Absolutely! We handle custom gaming builds, GPU replacements, overheating issues, performance optimization, and more.
faq.a4: Yes, we offer clean Windows installations, upgrades from older versions, and driver setup. We can also help with dual-boot configurations.
faq.a5: Yes, for software issues, virus removal, and system optimization, we can connect remotely and resolve issues without you leaving your home.
faq.a6: Absolutely. We follow strict data privacy protocols. Your files are never accessed or copied without your explicit permission. All data is treated with full confidentiality.
faq.a7: Yes, all repairs come with a warranty period ranging from 30 to 90 days depending on the type of repair. Parts replacements include manufacturer warranty.
faq.q8: What should I bring with my laptop?
faq.a8: Bring your device, its charger, and any relevant passwords if needed for diagnosis. If you have backup drives, bring those too for data recovery services.
